description: Governor's Secretariat - Central Province - Notify the Subjects under Ministries after Amendments
reasoning: This gazette exclusively details structural/administrative changes to the subjects and responsibilities of various ministries within the Central Provincial Council. It is issued by the Governor and amends the portfolio of subjects assigned to each ministry. No specific individuals are named in the body of the amendments; it only lists the ministries and their revised responsibilities, making it a clear example of an Organisational Gazette.
